description: How the viral databases of the EVE tool are built. build.py applies these criteria to a newer RVDB release, so a rebuilt database keeps the same selection biases as the published one. The RefSeq viral proteins and Swiss-Prot are fixed inputs: never downloaded by the build.

refseq_viral.source: fixed file, not downloaded: the installed diamond/sequences.fasta, or the file given with --refseq-fasta
refseq_viral.how_it_was_made: NCBI Virus web download of the RefSeq proteins of all viruses (taxid 10239), with the FASTA definition line built from the fields below
refseq_viral.note: Every RefSeq viral protein, all genome types: the screening needs the DNA and RT viruses too, to tell an EVE from a host gene.

rvdb.genome_type: family -> genome type from the curated table rvdb_family_genome_mapping.tsv; families missing there take the most common GenomicMoltype_s of their NCBI Virus RefSeq proteins

rescue_without_family.description: Models whose LCA is above family level (e.g. Viruses, Orthornavirae) are kept when their seed sequences are RNA viruses

eggnog.note: eggNOG 5.0 is no longer updated: these models are the same in every rebuild.

negatives.swissprot: fixed file, not downloaded: the installed DIAMOND/geral/uniprot_sprot.fasta, or the file given with --swissprot; viral proteins removed by taxonomy

calibration.positives: RefSeq viral proteins of non-retroviral RNA and ssDNA viruses (from refseq_viral)
